releases.title: Replies from a model on your own computer are no longer cut off

items.text: Replies from a model on your own computer (Ollama) that stopped in the middle, came back empty, or failed with "request exceeds the available context size".
An embedding model too slow for your computer no longer keeps the processor busy for ever.

releases.title: A check-up for your talking model, a thinking level for each chat

items.text: A Hard talk check for your talking model (Settings → Models & usage → Which model does what).
A thinking level for one conversation. In a chat's own settings pick Quick, Balanced or Thorough for that chat; Same as Settings follows the level you set for everything.
Worked and Did not work on each item of What's new, for you.
Models on your own computer that failed every time with "had a problem on its side (HTTP 500)" after Ollama updated itself.
An Ollama Cloud model used through Ollama on your computer is no longer counted as "free, all on this computer" in Usage and costs.
The "I can't search the web yet" notice no longer appears for ordinary sentences ("my brother does research", "I built a website").

releases.title: She stays with you in a hard conversation; the right tool in every language

items.text: She stays with you in a hard conversation. Grief, a breakup, loneliness, a bad day or a hard memory no longer get an answer about hotlines.
The bge-m3 embedding model is on the list under Settings → Models & usage → On this computer, for meaning search in many languages.
The crisis lines no longer appear for a cut finger, a gym injury, a film plot, the news, or someone else's death years ago.

releases.title: Meaning search with no setup, a thinking level, quicker long chats

items.text: Meaning search turns itself on. When an embedding model is already on this computer (for example in Ollama), she sets Meaning search to it once.
Research asks said your own way ("look into which air purifiers are worth buying", "get to the bottom of whether robot vacuums are worth it") reach your research model.
"How hard she thinks" (Settings → Models & usage → Default model): Quick, Balanced or Thorough.
On a computer that keeps one model loaded at a time, finding tools and research asks by meaning made every turn wait for two model loads and often got nothing for it.
A new install is no longer told its backups are more than 2 days old before the first one is made.

releases.title: The right tool at hand, the newest Claude models, research in six languages

items.text: She picks her tools by what you mean, not only by the words you use.
With a Claude model on an API key, what the model worked out before using a tool is handed back to it with the result.
She has the right tool at hand for more everyday ways of asking: "did the Packers win?", "when do the Lakers play next?", "start the clock", "be a bit less formal".
Asking her to research something in Spanish, French, German, Portuguese or Italian goes to your research model, as it did in English.
The newest Claude models work with an API key.

releases.title: Quicker to open, a tidier screen, Sara's own installer look

items.text: The Windows installer shows Sara's own picture and colors instead of the stock setup pictures.
Opening or reloading the app is quicker. Your browser now keeps the app's own files.
The notice bar for updates and known issues no longer covers the end of the chat.
On a phone, the top strip no longer takes a row just to repeat the model's name.

releases.title: Sign in with a code anywhere, one home for her messages, no freeze after replies

items.text: One home for what she sends on her own. The morning briefing, check-ins, weekly reviews, the roundup of smaller things and add-on notes arrive in From Sara.
The chat you used last is always at the top. Recent lists your five newest chats from every project, and projects are ordered by last use.
Replies are cheaper and quicker with every model that caches.
Several look-ups in one step run at the same time (pages, searches, files, her memory) instead of one after another.
Her look is made with the picture engine you picked.
A sign-in code from Settings now works on the sign-in page of a new computer.

releases.title: Safer with other people's words, complete backups, quicker with Claude

items.text: Replies with Claude models are faster and cheaper.
The app loads faster away from home. Its files are sent compressed: a first load is about 1.9 MB instead of 6.7 MB.
Words from a web page, an email, search results or a tool server can no longer ride Always allow everything.
She asks before fetching a web address that nobody wrote out while other people's words are in a chat.
Backups take a safe snapshot of every database, not only the main one.
